title: Problem Details
description: Error response (RFC 9457, D-51), media type application/problem+json. 'title' and 'detail' are fixed per type, in English, and never contain submitted values or internal data (CWE-209). The app reads 'status' and 'code' only and shows its own translated text.

type.description: Absolute URI fixed per problem type: <PROBLEM_BASE_URI><code>. Clients must not dereference it automatically (RFC 9457 §3.1.1).

instance.description: urn:uuid:<correlation id>, the same id written to the server log (ASVS 7.4.1).

code.description: Stable identifier read by the app; equals the last segment of 'type'.

errors.description: Only in 400 responses. Points at the field (JSON Pointer, RFC 6901) and says which rule failed; never repeats the submitted value.
